en.title: Transfers and chauffeur service
en.seo_title: Airport Transfers and Chauffeur Service in Marbella | Marbella in Style
en.metadesc: Private transfers from Málaga and Gibraltar airports and chauffeur service in Marbella with Mercedes E-Class, S-Class and V-Class, plus minibuses and coaches for groups of up to 50.
en.excerpt: Arrive without thinking about the road. We arrange private transfers from Málaga and Gibraltar airports, a chauffeur for your days out and transport for groups of any size, whether or not you are staying in one of our homes.
en.content:
Airport transfers

We work mainly with Málaga and Gibraltar airports. Your driver will be waiting for you on arrival and take you straight to your home or hotel.

Our vehicles

For groups and events

For weddings, celebrations or company trips we combine vehicles or use minibuses and coaches, so everyone arrives together.

How to book

Transfers are booked and paid in advance. When you ask for a quote, tell us:

  • the date, time and flight number;
  • where you are going;
  • how many passengers and how much luggage, including golf bags;
  • whether anyone travelling is under 12, so we can plan for an approved child seat or booster.

Book your transfer. Request a quote

en.title: Private chef in Marbella
en.seo_title: Private Chef in Marbella | For One Meal or Your Whole Stay | Marbella in Style
en.metadesc: Book a private chef in your Marbella villa for a barbecue, a paella or every day of your stay. Tell us what you would like and we will prepare a quote.
en.excerpt: Some of the best meals of a holiday happen at home, by the pool, with nobody needing to cook. We arrange private chefs for a single occasion or for your whole stay.
en.content:
For one meal

Book a chef for one day of your stay: a barbecue in the garden, a paella by the pool, or a special dinner.

Full-service chef

For longer stays, a full-service chef takes care of the service day after day, so you only have to sit down at the table.

How it works

  • Tell us the dates, how many guests, the kind of meal you would like and any allergies or dietary needs.
  • We prepare a quote for the chef's service.
  • The food is always paid separately from the chef's service.

Plan your meals with us. Request a quote

en.title: Private Alhambra and Granada tour from Marbella
en.seo_title: Private Alhambra and Granada Tour from Marbella | Marbella in Style
en.metadesc: A private day trip from Marbella to Granada with pick-up, Alhambra tickets, a guided visit of the Alhambra and a walk through the Albaicín.
en.excerpt: A day in Granada with your own driver and guide: a two-and-a-half-hour guided visit of the Alhambra, with tickets included, and an afternoon walk through the old town and the Albaicín.
en.content:
The Alhambra limits the number of visitors each day, so the tour depends on tickets being available for your date, and the pick-up time is set by the time of your Alhambra entry. Book as early as you can.

Itinerary

What's included

  • Private pick-up and return.
  • Private driver and guide.
  • Alhambra tickets.
  • Guided visit of the Alhambra.
  • Walking tour of the Albaicín.

Not included

  • Food and drink.
  • Tips.

Extras

  • Expert official Alhambra guide: +€250.
  • Granada Cathedral tickets: +€5 per person.

Good to know

  • Bring your passport or ID card.
  • Wear comfortable clothes and shoes.
  • Children are welcome. Not suitable for wheelchairs; pets are not allowed.
  • The tour is private and can be adapted to your group.

Cancellation

More than 15 days before the tour: full refund minus a 10% administration fee. Between 5 and 15 days: 75% refund. Within 5 days: no refund. Alhambra tickets already bought are deducted from any refund.

es.title: Tour privado a la Alhambra y Granada desde Marbella
es.seo_title: Tour privado a la Alhambra y Granada desde Marbella | Marbella in Style
es.metadesc: Excursión privada de Marbella a Granada con recogida, entradas a la Alhambra, visita guiada de la Alhambra y paseo por el Albaicín.
es.excerpt: Un día en Granada con conductor y guía para vosotros: visita guiada de dos horas y media a la Alhambra, con las entradas incluidas, y por la tarde un paseo por el centro y el Albaicín.
es.content:
La Alhambra limita el número de visitas al día, así que el tour depende de que haya entradas para tu fecha, y la hora de recogida la marca la hora de entrada. Resérvalo con la mayor antelación posible.

Programa

Qué incluye

  • Recogida y regreso privados.
  • Conductor y guía privados.
  • Entradas a la Alhambra.
  • Visita guiada a la Alhambra.
  • Paseo por el Albaicín.

No incluye

  • Comida y bebida.
  • Propinas.

Extras

  • Guía oficial experto de la Alhambra: +250 €.
  • Entradas a la Catedral de Granada: +5 € por persona.

Bueno saberlo

  • Lleva el DNI o el pasaporte.
  • Ropa y calzado cómodos.
  • Los niños son bienvenidos. No es apto para sillas de ruedas y no se admiten mascotas.
  • El tour es privado y se puede adaptar a vuestro grupo.

Cancelación

Con más de 15 días de antelación: reembolso completo menos un 10 % de gastos de gestión. Entre 5 y 15 días: reembolso del 75 %. Con menos de 5 días: sin reembolso. Las entradas de la Alhambra ya compradas se descuentan del reembolso.

en.title: Private Tangier tour from Marbella
en.seo_title: Private Tangier Day Trip from Marbella with Ferry | Marbella in Style
en.metadesc: A private day in Tangier from Marbella: pick-up, ferry from Tarifa, a local guide, the Caves of Hercules, Cape Spartel and the Kasbah.
en.excerpt: Cross to Africa for the day. We drive you to the port of Tarifa, you take the ferry to Tangier (about an hour), and a private local guide shows you the modern city, the coast to the Caves of Hercules and Cape Spartel, and the Kasbah before you head back across the Strait.
en.content:
How you travel

  • To Tarifa: an air-conditioned Mercedes V-Class or minibus, depending on the size of your group.
  • To Tangier: by ferry from Tarifa. Ferry tickets are included.
  • In Tangier: an air-conditioned minibus.

Itinerary

What's included

  • Private pick-up and return.
  • Ferry tickets.
  • Private local guide in Tangier.
  • Sightseeing tour of Tangier.
  • Entry to the Caves of Hercules.

Not included

  • Food and drink.

Extras

  • Traditional tea on a hotel terrace.
  • Camel ride.

Good to know

  • Bring a passport valid for your trip. Depending on your nationality, you may need a visa for Morocco: check before you book.
  • Wear comfortable clothes and shoes.
  • Children are welcome. Not suitable for wheelchairs; pets are not allowed.
  • Tell us about any dietary requirements when you book.
  • The tour is private and can be adapted to your group.

Cancellation

More than 15 days before the tour: full refund minus a 10% administration fee. Between 5 and 15 days: 75% refund. Within 5 days: no refund. Tickets already bought, including the ferry, are deducted from any refund.

es.title: Tour privado a Tánger desde Marbella

es.metadesc: Un día privado en Tánger desde Marbella: recogida, ferry desde Tarifa, guía local, cuevas de Hércules, cabo Espartel y la Kasbah.
es.excerpt: Cruza a África por un día. Te llevamos al puerto de Tarifa, tomas el ferry a Tánger (alrededor de una hora) y un guía local privado te enseña la ciudad moderna, la costa hasta las cuevas de Hércules y el cabo Espartel, y la Kasbah antes de volver a cruzar el Estrecho.
es.content:
Cómo se viaja

  • Hasta Tarifa: Mercedes Clase V o minibús con aire acondicionado, según el tamaño del grupo.
  • Hasta Tánger: en ferry desde Tarifa. Los billetes van incluidos.
  • En Tánger: minibús con aire acondicionado.

Programa

Qué incluye

  • Recogida y regreso privados.
  • Billetes de ferry.
  • Guía local privado en Tánger.
  • Visita turística de Tánger.
  • Entrada a las cuevas de Hércules.

No incluye

  • Comida y bebida.

Extras

  • Té tradicional en la terraza de un hotel.
  • Paseo en camello.

Bueno saberlo

  • Lleva el pasaporte en vigor. Según tu nacionalidad, puede que necesites visado para Marruecos: compruébalo antes de reservar.
  • Ropa y calzado cómodos.

Cancelación

Con más de 15 días de antelación: reembolso completo menos un 10 % de gastos de gestión. Entre 5 y 15 días: reembolso del 75 %. Con menos de 5 días: sin reembolso. Las entradas y billetes ya comprados, incluido el ferry, se descuentan del reembolso.

en.excerpt: A day in the mountains with your own driver and guide. You visit two wineries around Ronda, taste their wines, and walk through the old town and across to the bullring.
en.content:
Itinerary

The order can change depending on the wineries' availability.

What's included

  • Private pick-up and return in an air-conditioned vehicle.
  • Private guide.
  • Visits and wine tastings at two wineries.
  • Guided walk through Ronda.
  • Entry to the Ronda bullring.

Not included

  • Breakfast, lunch and other food and drink.

Good to know

  • Minimum two people.
  • Wear comfortable clothes and shoes.
  • Children are welcome. The legal drinking age in Spain is 18. Not suitable for wheelchairs.
  • Tell us about any dietary requirements when you book.

Cancellation

More than 15 days before the tour: full refund minus a 10% administration fee. Between 5 and 15 days: 75% refund. Within 5 days: no refund. Tickets already bought are deducted from any refund.

en.title: Tapas and wine in Marbella Old Town
en.seo_title: Private Tapas and Wine Tour in Marbella Old Town | Marbella in Style
en.metadesc: A three-hour private walk through Marbella Old Town with tapas in two local spots, wine and an olive oil tasting. Starts at 12:00 or 16:00 from the Alameda fountain.
en.excerpt: Three hours on foot through the old town of Marbella with your own guide, stopping for tapas in two local places, tasting wine and trying Andalusian olive oil. The tour is private, so it moves at your pace and can be adapted to your group.
en.content:
Practical details

  • Duration: 3 hours.
  • Starts: 12:00 or 16:00.
  • Meeting point: the fountain in Parque de la Alameda. Pick-up from your accommodation is not included, but we can add it as an extra.
  • Private tour with a live guide in English, Spanish, German or Russian.

What's included

  • Private guide.
  • Walking tour of Marbella Old Town.
  • Tapas tasting in two local venues.
  • Wine tasting.
  • Olive oil tasting.

Not included

  • Pick-up and drop-off (available as an extra).

Good to know

  • Wear comfortable shoes.
  • Children are welcome. The legal drinking age in Spain is 18.
  • Tell us about any dietary requirements when you book.
  • The route is not suitable for wheelchairs, and pets are not allowed.

Cancellation

Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the start. Between 24 and 48 hours we refund 25%; within 24 hours there is no refund. You can change the date up to 48 hours before, subject to availability (a 10% fee may apply).

es.title: Tapas y vinos en el casco antiguo de Marbella
es.seo_title: Tour privado de tapas y vinos por el casco antiguo de Marbella | Marbella in Style
es.metadesc: Tres horas a pie por el casco antiguo de Marbella, con tapas en dos sitios locales, vino y cata de aceite. Salidas a las 12:00 o las 16:00 desde la fuente de la Alameda.
es.excerpt: Tres horas a pie por el casco antiguo de Marbella con tu propio guía: tapas en dos sitios locales, vino y una cata de aceite de oliva andaluz. Es un tour privado, así que va a vuestro ritmo y se puede adaptar al grupo.
es.content:
Datos prácticos

  • Duración: 3 horas.
  • Salidas: 12:00 o 16:00.
  • Punto de encuentro: la fuente del Parque de la Alameda. La recogida en tu alojamiento no está incluida, pero podemos añadirla como extra.
  • Tour privado con guía en español, inglés, alemán o ruso.

Qué incluye

  • Guía privado.
  • Paseo por el casco antiguo de Marbella.
  • Tapas en dos locales.
  • Degustación de vino.
  • Cata de aceite de oliva.

No incluye

  • Recogida y regreso (disponible como extra).

Bueno saberlo

  • Lleva calzado cómodo.
  • Los niños son bienvenidos. En España, la edad legal para beber alcohol es 18 años.
  • Si tienes alguna necesidad de dieta, dínoslo al reservar.
  • El recorrido no es apto para sillas de ruedas y no se admiten mascotas.

Cancelación

Cancelación gratuita hasta 48 horas antes del inicio. Entre 24 y 48 horas devolvemos el 25 %; con menos de 24 horas no hay reembolso. Puedes cambiar la fecha hasta 48 horas antes, según disponibilidad (puede aplicarse un cargo del 10 %).
